study_identification_part.si_4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Discovery dataset from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University and Replication dataset from the Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Two independent Chinese dataset were included in this study: a discovery dataset (105 never-treated first-episode patients and matched 130 HCs) and a replication dataset (106 patients and matched 126 HCs).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls from both discovery and replication datasets were used to train/test the normative models. Patient data was used for individualized atrophy assessment and disease epicenter identification.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients. ... Reproduced on the replication dataset.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern; Methods / Participants

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model 1 used 130 HCs from the discovery dataset. Model 2 used 126 HCs from the replication dataset. The specific training/testing split within these healthy samples was not explicitly stated for the GPR training.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The discovery dataset included ... matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) ... The replication dataset included ... matched 126 HCs. ... we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Participants; Methods / Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics for healthy controls in the discovery (Model 1) and replication (Model 2) datasets as reported in Table 1.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution for HCs. Male counts were calculated from total N and the male percentages provided in Table 1. Discovery (N=130): 45.38% male (58.99 -> 59 male, 71 female). Replication (N=126): 47.17% male (59.43 -> 59 male, 67 female).
